metadata.artifact: issue-198 normalized extract (projection) of ESPN core API v2 by-athlete season statistics

season.selectionBasis: season/type taken from the source URL and each row's season/seasonType $refs in the fixture itself

rawFixture.hashScope: the SHA-256 is over the exact raw decoded bytes of the fixture file, not over gzip bytes or any JSON reserialization

transform.duplicatePolicy: duplicate athlete ID, duplicate stat name within a row, or unexpected split shape aborts the extraction; nothing is silently resolved or dropped
transform.missingPolicy: absent stat stays absent, null stays null, non-numeric value passes through verbatim; no zero-filling anywhere; an athlete with no fixture row has no extract row (absent = UNSCORED)
transform.valuePolicy: values emitted exactly as published; no recomputation and no quantization in the projection
transform.serialization: rows sorted by numeric athlete ID; fixed key order (id, then fields in FIELDS order); compact separators; UTF-8; single trailing newline

metadata.displayNames: not present in this payload: each row's athlete object carries only a $ref, so the extract is ID-keyed with no name field; identity never comes from a name join

coverage.eligibilityNote: observed IDs = every row emitted; model-eligible IDs (under the counterproposal's E) = rows with gamesPlayed >= 20; low-GP rows are preserved, not filtered out
